free_tier.stated: 30,000 credits a month on the Free plan, with up to 5 active users and 30x concurrency; open-source projects get up to 400,000 credits a month for Linux, Arm and Docker builds, and macOS and Windows open-source builds draw on the 30,000

per_object_cap.stated: 1 hour maximum job runtime on the Free plan; 3 hours on Performance and 5 hours on Scale

retention.stated: credits expire monthly and do not roll over; caches and artifacts expire per configuration

egress.terms: network transfer is billed only for traffic from CircleCI to self-hosted runners; the Free plan includes 1 GB of network transfer and 2 GB-months of storage, and use beyond these draws from the monthly credits at 420 credits per GB

interface_detail: a .circleci/config.yml pipeline; the CircleCI API and CLI
tooling: the CircleCI convenience images; docker; any shell
chaining: the largest credit pool of the hosted CI providers here, and the only one that scales with public rather than private visibility by a factor above ten

limits.value: 30,000 credits a month on Free; every credit expires at the end of the month
30x concurrency on Free, and 5 active users
1 hour maximum job runtime on the Free plan

identity_cost.detail: an email address and a password, verified by email, for GitHub, GitLab or Cursor Origin projects; a Bitbucket account for Bitbucket Cloud projects; the Free plan needs no credit card

confidence_note: the pricing page was read; the credits doc was read for the overage rate. The 5,000-credit figure in circulation is the pre-2025 plan.

evidence.proved: Free: 30,000 credits a month, 5 active users, 30x concurrency; 400,000 credits a month for public repositories
